notes: Complete list of what is registered: 53 actions (src/actions.js, assigned as actions.<id> and registered with one setActionDefinitions call in updateActions) and 4 advanced feedbacks (src/feedbacks.js). Three further actions (resource_settings_color, resource_folder_transcode, resource_multiresource) exist only inside comment blocks and are not catalogued; some option entries and choices inside active actions are commented out as well and are ignored.

Protocol: Pixera JSON/TCP API over a TCP connection (TCPHelper), default port 1400 (src/config.js). Each JSON-RPC style message is prefixed with the bytes of "pxr1" and a length field (src/Pixera.js:276-288). companion/HELP.md names API revision 367; the module asks for the API revision at connect. The config has an "Enable Polling feedbacks?" checkbox with a polling rate of 50, 100, 200, 500 or 1000 ms, and the config text says to use the API function at your own risk.

The definitions are rebuilt by updateActions() every time a list reply arrives (timelines, screens, live systems, projectors, outputs, resources, studio cameras), so the dropdown choices of a running connection differ from the placeholder lists; those dropdowns carry choicesNote and valueType numeric (the ids are numeric handles that the module reads with parseInt).

Several text inputs use regex: self.REGEX_FLOAT, self.REGEX_NUMBER or self.REGEX_INT. Nothing in this module defines these properties, so they are undefined and the fields have no effective pattern; no regex is recorded. Fields documented as numbers (positions, scale, volume, frames, time parts) are plain text inputs parsed with parseFloat or parseInt at run time, and their defaults are strings such as "0.0".

Source default/choice mismatches, recorded exactly as written: timeline_transport option mode has the string default "1" while the choice ids are numbers (1 to 4); session_livesystem option session_livesystem_action has default 0, which is not among its choices (1, 2, 3).

Some actions send raw API calls: api (api_methode) sends the text as a JSON-RPC message, controlAction calls a Pixera control path with arguments, layerParameter writes a layer parameter by path. These can trigger anything the Pixera API accepts.

Feedbacks: timeline_state, timeline_positions and timeline_countdowns match the timeline by name (text input, default 0 as in the source) against the timeline state that the module keeps (CHOICES_TIMELINEFEEDBACK); the state is refreshed by a polling timer that the config checkbox enables (src/Pixera.js:158-165). companion/HELP.md states that the live system state feedback requires polling.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.4.3: options do not support expressions.
